<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Item 3.02. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">On December&nbsp;31, 2025, Golub Capital Private Income Fund I (the
 &ldquo;Fund&rdquo;) issued unregistered common shares of beneficial interest in the Fund, par value $0.01 (the &ldquo;Common Shares&rdquo;),
to certain accredited investors in the initial closing of its private offering (the &ldquo;Private Offering&rdquo;). The purchase price
per Common Share was equal to $25.00. The table below details the Common Shares sold on December&nbsp;31, 2025. The offer and sale of
the Common Shares were exempt from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, pursuant to Section&nbsp;4(a)(2),
Regulation D, and/or Regulation S thereunder. GC Advisors LLC (the &ldquo;Adviser&rdquo;) (and not the Fund) contributed a portion of
the proceeds used to purchase the Common Shares on behalf of shareholders from the Adviser&rsquo;s own resources.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom">
    <TD STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Date of Unregistered Sale</B></FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 1pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD COLSPAN="2" STYLE="border-bottom: black 1pt solid; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Amount of Common Shares<SUP></SUP></B></FONT></TD>

for its Common Shares in the amount per share set forth below:</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The January&nbsp;regular distributions for the Common Shares are payable
to shareholders of record as of January&nbsp;31, 2026 and will be paid on or around February&nbsp;26, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">These distributions will be paid in cash or reinvested in Common Shares
of the Fund for shareholders participating in the Fund&rsquo;s distribution reinvestment plan.</P>
